study_area: Autzen Stadium area, Eugene, Oregon, USA
interpretation: Exploratory terrain-screening indicator based on slope classes. The class thresholds are descriptive and are not validated hazard, landslide, accessibility, or safety thresholds.
limitations: Results depend on DEM resolution and slope-processing settings.
Slope alone cannot establish landslide or other hazard risk.
No field validation or hazard inventory was used.
Percentages describe valid raster cells, not the entire study area.
